Form

SettingsRow

List row that composes a title, optional subtitle, and a trailing control (Switch, chevron, badge, or custom) for settings screens.

Import

tsx
import { SettingsRow } from "@mvp-ui-rn/ui"

Usage

tsx
import { SettingsRow } from "@mvp-ui-rn/ui"

<SettingsRow
  title="Push notifications"
  subtitle="Receive alerts for new messages"
  trailing={
    <Switch checked={notifications} onCheckedChange={setNotifications} />
  }
/>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
titlerequired
string—

Primary row label.

subtitle
string—

Secondary description text rendered below the title.

trailing
ReactNode—

Element rendered at the trailing edge (Switch, Text, Icon, etc.).

onPress
() => void—

Makes the row a Pressable and fires on tap.

iconLeading
IconProp—

Icon rendered at the leading edge.

isDisabled
booleanfalse

Disables press interaction and applies reduced opacity.

React Native Notes

  • Group multiple SettingsRow items inside a Card with dividers for a standard iOS settings appearance.
  • Row height is at least 56pt so the trailing switch is comfortable to tap.
  • Do not embed another Pressable in trailing — the row itself is Pressable when onPress is provided.
